rows.grounds: demonstrative referring to the previously named yoginīs
compound indicating worship preceded by the hṛllekhā bīja; hṛllekhā kept as mantra name

items.question: What mantra-seed must precede the worship of these Yoginīs?
premises: The subject is the worship of these Yoginīs.
Their worship is specified as having a preceding element.
That preceding element is the hṛllekhā bīja.
items.inference: Therefore, the worship of these Yoginīs must be preceded by the hṛllekhā bīja.
uncertainties: The exact ritual form of placing the hṛllekhā bīja before the worship is not specified in this verse.
items.plain_english: Indeed, the worship of these Yoginīs is to be preceded by the hṛllekhā seed-mantra.
